import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.feature_selection import mutual_info_classif
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler

MAX_DRIVERS = 5

def design(feats):
    # Remove near-duplicates based on correlation
    ids = list(feats.ids)
    types = list(feats.types)
    X = feats.x
    y = feats.y
    
    # Build correlation matrix
    corr_matrix = np.corrcoef(X.T)
    to_remove = set()
    for i in range(len(ids)):
        for j in range(i+1, len(ids)):
            if abs(corr_matrix[i,j]) >= 0.6:
                to_remove.add(j)
    
    # Filter features
    keep = [i for i in range(len(ids)) if i not in to_remove]
    filtered_ids = [ids[i] for i in keep]
    filtered_X = X[:, keep]
    
    # Compute t-statistics for each feature
    t_stats = []
    for i in range(len(filtered_ids)):
        group0 = filtered_X[y==0, i]
        group1 = filtered_X[y==1, i]
        t_stat, _ = stats.ttest_ind(group0, group1, equal_var=False)
        t_stats.append(abs(t_stat))
    
    # Sort by t-statistic magnitude
    sorted_indices = np.argsort(t_stats)[::-1]
    top_features = [filtered_ids[i] for i in sorted_indices[:MAX_DRIVERS]]
    
    # Check if any features show strong association (t > 4)
    strong_features = [f for f, t in zip(top_features, [t_stats[i] for i in sorted_indices[:MAX_DRIVERS]]) if t > 4]
    
    # If no strong features, return empty design
    if not strong_features:
        return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
    
    # Limit to at most 4 drivers as required
    drivers = tuple(strong_features[:4])
    columns = tuple(strong_features[:4])
    
    # Add interaction terms for top two features if they exist
    products = ()
    if len(strong_features) >= 2:
        products = ((strong_features[0], strong_features[1]),)
    
    # Weighted score using top feature
    loadings = {strong_features[0]: 1.0}
    
    return Design(drivers=drivers, columns=columns, products=products, loadings=loadings)
